summary: This note surveys classic Southern desserts state by state, pairing each with a baker or expert and the story behind the recipe. It covers Mississippi Mud Pie, Louisiana King Cake, Carolina peach cobbler, Tennessee stack cake, Kentucky bourbon balls, Alabama Lane Cake, Virginia chess pie and Texas tres leches. The main theme is that these desserts carry history, community and regional ingredients.
one_line: A tour of eight Southern desserts, from Mississippi Mud Pie to Texas tres leches, with the bakers and traditions behind each.
key_facts: Rosa Simmons of Greenwood, Mississippi, baked her Mississippi Mud Pie on October 3rd, 2023, and the article presents it as the start of a revival in traditional Southern dessert making.
Rosa Simmons's Mississippi Mud Pie has a dense chocolate crust and a marshmallow-infused fudge layer, topped with whipped cream; she credits freshly churned butter and homegrown pecans for its taste.
Antoine Broussard's family bakery has handcrafted King Cakes in New Orleans since 1962; the cake is a sweet brioche dough twisted with cinnamon-infused sugar.
A King Cake hides a tiny baby figurine, and whoever finds it gets luck and responsibility and hosts the next year's Mardi Gras party.
At a September 15, 2023 competition in Charleston, Ella Mae's peach cobbler stood out, made with cinnamon from wild trees on her property and flour from a local, historic mill.

Tennessee's stack cake was introduced on September 18, 2023 by baker Thomas Sullivan; neighbors traditionally each brought a layer to a wedding, stacked with apple preserve filling, and layers could reach twelve.

Margaret Cooper, a Lexington, Kentucky confectioner, said on September 30, 2023 that bourbon quality matters most; her Bourbon Balls combine crushed nuts, chocolate and bourbon, hand-dipped in premium dark chocolate.
The Lane Cake was originally crafted by Emma Rylander Lane in the late 19th century; it is layered, bourbon-laced, filled with raisins, pecans and coconut, and covered in fluffy white frosting.
Susan Hartley led a Lane Cake baking class on September 22, 2023, insisting on Alabama pecans and fresh coconut, and noting the flavors intensify after several days.

James Monroe (no relation to the president) bakes Chess Pie in Richmond, Virginia; it is made of sugar, butter and eggs, and he adds lemon zest or nutmeg for a modern twist. The origin of the name remains a mystery.
Maria Elena Ramirez of San Antonio, a third-generation baker, showed her Tres Leches Cake on September 8, 2023; it is soaked in evaporated milk, condensed milk and heavy cream.
Ramirez uses her grandmother's handwritten family recipe and rests the cake a full 24 hours for maximum moistness.
